text: Program Description Genetics -- the study of genetic and genetic variation in organisms. Future Career Graduates may go to institutions of higher learning and scientific research institutes for teaching, scientific research and management. Can also be used in industry, medicine, food, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery, environmental protection, quarantine, garden industry enterprises, undertakings and administrative departments engaged in genetics related aspects and so on application research, technology development and industrialization of technical work as well as the production management and administrative management work; In addition, the science and technology content of the genetics major is very high, so it is necessary for the students of this discipline to continue their study in the future to engage in professional scientific research. Duration 3 years
